required_workflow_literals:
- name: Install CUDA toolkit (full)
        id: cuda
        timeout-minutes: 12
        uses: Jimver/cuda-toolkit@v0.2.24   # settled action version; has CUDA 12.8.1 (first with sm_120)
        with:
          cuda: '12.8.1'
          method: 'network'
          # Newer CUDA network installs reject a bare "full" fetch — pin the components candle-CUDA
          # (cudart/cublas/curand/nvrtc + dev import libs) and the llama.cpp nvcc build need.
          # nvcc builds the Rust/CUDA frontend directly. IDE registration can hang in
          # devenv on hosted runners; only a native DLL cache miss needs MSBuild integration.
          sub-packages: '["nvcc", "cudart", "cublas", "cublas_dev", "curand", "curand_dev", "nvrtc", "nvrtc_dev", "thrust"]'

      # nvcc (candle-kernels) needs the MSVC host compiler cl.exe on PATH.

- name: Install CUDA MSBuild integration only for native DLL rebuild
        if: steps.cuda_engine_cache.outputs.hit != 'true'
        timeout-minutes: 12
        uses: Jimver/cuda-toolkit@v0.2.24
        with:
          cuda: '12.8.1'
          method: 'network'
          sub-packages: '["visual_studio_integration"]'
